# pai cockpit

The router's web cockpit: layout export

```
pai cockpit <command>
```

Maintenance for the cockpit page served by the router.

```sh
pai cockpit layout export
```

See also: `pai router status`

### pai cockpit layout

The cockpit's default window layout

```
pai cockpit layout <command>
```

The default layout new devices start from.

```sh
pai cockpit layout export
```

#### pai cockpit layout export

Write the saved default cockpit layout to the repo's shipped defaults file

```
pai cockpit layout export [options]
```

Copies the layout the cockpit's "save as default" button saved (PAI_HOME/cockpit-layout-default.json) to src/config/defaults/cockpit-layout.json, which ships with the package and is what a new install's devices start from. Only runs on this command; commit the file afterwards.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--to FILE` | string | — | Write here instead of the checkout's shipped file |

```sh
pai cockpit layout export
```

See also: `pai router status`
